); } // --- Helper Components --- function ScheduleCell({ text }) { if (text === "-") return -; let bgColor = '#e0f2fe'; let textColor = '#0369a1'; if (text.includes("Science")) { bgColor = '#dcfce7'; textColor = '#15803d'; } else if (text.includes("Maths")) { bgColor = '#fef9c3'; textColor = '#a16207'; } else if (text.includes("Physics")) { bgColor = '#f3e8ff'; textColor = '#6b21a8'; } else if (text.includes("Class") || text.includes("Revision")) { bgColor = '#fee2e2'; textColor = '#991b1b'; } return ( {text} ); } // Stat Cards වල උස (height: '110px') වැඩි කර පල්ලෙහාට ගත්තා function StatCard({ title, value, accentColor, icon }) { return (
